examples.arabic: هو حمل أكياسًا فيها طعام شهي.
examples.english: He carried bags containing delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Huwa hamala akyaasan feeha ta'amun shahiyy.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: حقا ان تجمعات العائلة دائما ما تجمع الفرح والطعام الشهي معا
examples.english: Indeed, family gatherings always bring joy and delicious food together.
examples.transliteration: Haqqan inna tajammu'aat al-'aa'ila daa'iman maa tajma' al-farah wat-ta'aam ash-shahiyy ma'an.

examples.arabic: وبعد ساعات من العمل ظهر الطبق التقليدي بشكل شهي ونكهة رائعة
examples.english: After hours of work, the traditional dish appeared delicious with a wonderful flavor
examples.transliteration: Wa baʿda sāʿāt min al-ʿamal ẓahara aṭ-ṭabaqu at-taqlīdī bi-shaklin shahī wa nakhatin rā'iʿah

examples.arabic: كان ابني وابنتي ينتظران بفارغ الصبر رائحة الطعام الشهي
examples.english: My son and daughter were eagerly awaiting the delicious smell of the food.
examples.transliteration: kana ibni wa ibnati yantazirani bifarighi al-sabri ra'ihat at-ta'ami ash-shahiyy
examples.storyTitle: Preparing a New Dish for the Family
